articles.headline: Liga MX Femenil rebrands, changes season format
articles.description: Mexican women's top-flight side Liga MX Femenil announced a rebrand to Liga Femenil BBVA, along with a change in the competition's regular season format.

articles.headline: Mexico great Guillermo Ochoa retires after 22-year career
articles.description: Guillermo Ochoa, widely considered among the greatest Mexican goalkeepers in history, announced his retirement from elite soccer on Tuesday, bringing an end to a distinguished 22-year professional career.

images.name: Mexico's goalkeeper #13 Guillermo Ochoa [1296x729]
images.credit: Ulises RUIZ / AFP via Getty Images

articles.headline: Keylor Navas headlines Liga MX squad for MLS ASG
articles.description: Costa Rican goalkeeper Keylor Navas, a three-time World Cup participant, and Mexican teen phenom Gilberto Mora headline the Liga MX squad set to face MLS stars in the All-Star Game on July 29 in Charlotte, North Carolina.

articles.headline: Mexico's Mora is poised to be World Cup's breakout star: 'This guy is different'
articles.description: Getting beyond the quarterfinals would be historic for Mexico. Lucky for El Tri, they have a 17-year-old who can't stop making history.

images.name: Gilberto Mora 251115 [1296x729]
images.caption: Gilberto Mora is a threat for Mexico.

images.name: Will Mexico or South Korea top Group A at the World Cup?
images.caption: Gab & Juls debate who will win Group A between Mexico, South Korea, Czechia and South Africa at the FIFA World Cup.

articles.headline: Jardine out as Club América coach after winning six titles in three years

images.name: Jardine [1296x729]
images.caption: André Jardine has departed Club América as the most decorated coach in the club's history.

articles.headline: Cruz Azul rallies past Pumas to win Liga MX Clausura title
articles.description: Rodolfo Rotondi played the villain role in 2024 by conceding a penalty that cost Cruz Azul the championship match. On Sunday, the Argentine midfielder redeemed himself.

images.name: Cruz Azul trophy lift_260524 [1024x576]
